measurement: JUnit testcase time (setup+call+teardown) of the authenticated CI V4 PR shard artifacts of ONE hosted run; artifact zip SHA-256 equals the GitHub API digest. Nodes absent here are NEW for the performance guard.
scope_note: Covers the 2,284 nodes that run selected for #457. A node never selected by a measured run has no baseline yet; it is judged by new_node_without_baseline_seconds until a later owner-reviewed refresh records it.
